scope: CRD-01 through CRD-11 full reachable API behavior and shared dependencies; source/handoff read-only.

tests.environment: isolated synthetic PostgreSQL at 127.0.0.1:55441/flowboard_harness; approved local TCP access

security.reason: Project/grant locks and minimal receipts are sound; stale lifecycle replay can return an outcome after card access changes.

correctness.reason: Rank/neighbor, moving-card, overdue-search and card-cursor behavior contradict documented requirements.

integrity.reason: Invalid neighbor pairs can create duplicate ranks; concurrent OCC and lifecycle replay races are not covered.

tests.reason: Requested focused PostgreSQL suite and typecheck pass; key negative cases and the broader frozen command family are not evidenced in this card review.

maintainability.reason: Typed boundaries and shared locks are readable, but duplicated adapter routes plus mount-order ambiguity complicate reachability.

operations.reason: Meets minimum; pagination is bounded but stale-cursor and rank-recovery behavior have gaps.

findings.description: apps/api/src/adapters/cards.ts:681-772: null/null neighbors set rank 1000 without checking emptiness; two existing nonadjacent destination neighbors are accepted and midpoint rank can collide because DB position index is non-unique.
findings.counterevidence: Board lock/OCC serializes normal moves and tests cover valid positions; no adjacency, empty-destination, or unique-rank assertion.

findings.description: Mounted boardsRoutes placement adapter apps/api/src/adapters/boards.ts:740-780 never loads or validates movingCardId; it returns 200 placement for nonexistent, trashed, or foreign IDs. Route mount order puts boardsRoutes before cardsRoutes.
findings.counterevidence: Board/column and project access are checked; valid placement cases pass.

findings.description: Project search apps/api/src/adapters/cards.ts:1085-1091 marks all due_date < CURRENT_DATE as overdue, including done-column cards and ignoring workspace timezone. FEATURE_SPEC excludes done cards and defines workspace today.
findings.counterevidence: Board listing helper excludes done cards; project search is a separate route and remains faulty.

findings.description: Mounted board card cursor has only position/id in apps/api/src/adapters/boards.ts:36-60,1239-1265; no filter/board/snapshot binding or stale-snapshot detection. Cursor reuse or intervening moves/inserts can skip or repeat cards, contrary to API.md.
findings.counterevidence: Same-filter valid continuation and malformed JSON cursor checks exist; cross-scope reuse and mutation between pages are not tested.

findings.description: PATCH/move routes read card state outside the transaction and before receipt lookup (apps/api/src/http/routes/cards.ts:148-157,221-230). Concurrent trash can win after this read; receipt replay then returns before the adapter locks/rechecks active card lifecycle.
findings.counterevidence: New non-replay commands lock and check active state; project/archive/grant locks are correctly checked before receipt lookup. No trash/replay race test exists.

coverageGaps: Full npm run check and BRD/COM/DEL suites not run in this cards subreview.
CRD-10 stale-version tests are sequential, not concurrent edit/move requests.
No PostgreSQL negative test for rank collision, invalid movingCardId, project-search overdue done-card exclusion, card cursor scope/snapshot binding, or trash racing card replay.
No Worker dry-run, browser/UI, hosted or production verification.
hardBlockers: F-01 duplicate or noncanonical rank outcome
F-02 placement accepts invalid moving card identity
F-04 card cursors are not bound to scope/filter/snapshot
F-05 card mutation replay can outlive active lifecycle
Category minima fail; weighted total does not exceed 8.5
